company.name: R2
company.shortDescription: R2 is an embedded lending platform that offers capital for businesses.
company.description: R2 enables platforms to seamlessly offer to finance to their SMB buyers and sellers in Latin America. R2 partners with well-known companies, such as Rappi and Clip, to power their capital arms. R2 raises GMV for merchants, promotes retention by becoming their trusted financing supplier, and opens up a new revenue stream.

productsAndServices.description: A lending infrastructure platform that enables e-commerce, marketplace, payments, POS, delivery, and SaaS platforms to offer financing to their merchants under an integrated or white-label experience.
productsAndServices.name: Embedded Lending Platform

productsAndServices.description: A financing product that provides merchants with upfront capital and collects repayment as a percentage of their sales, allowing payment amounts to vary with platform revenue.
productsAndServices.name: Revenue-Based Financing

productsAndServices.description: API and SDK components that allow platforms to embed financing offers, loan applications, balance information, and related lending functions into existing digital workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Lending APIs and SDKs

productsAndServices.description: Operational services covering data-driven underwriting, merchant verification, regulatory compliance, funding, loan servicing, customer support, and collections for embedded lending programs.
productsAndServices.name: Lending Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Collections
